page.margins_note: All three image decks are 1.294 (850x656, 1056x816, 1100x849). Classic template: content spans ~4.5% to ~95.5% of width (~0.5in side margins); logo block sits in top-left corner at ~2-4% inset; a thin gray horizontal rule at ~19-20% of page height separates the title zone from the body; bottom rule at ~93% above footer. 2026 template: ~0.4in margins, thin steel-blue rule at very top (~3%) and another under the title (~17%).

typography.confidence: Medium-high for Arial-like grotesque in 2023-24 decks (Enstar HTML literally specifies Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; filing-agent CSS, so only corroborative). Medium for the 2026 serif/humanist pairing (looks like Goldman's proprietary brand faces; exact face unknown). Point sizes approx from pixel height vs 612pt page height; Enstar HTML sizes (14pt titles, 7-8pt tables, 5.5pt footnotes) are scaled by the agent and not reliable. Myovant and Janus confirm the Arial-like bold navy title in the classic template (2022 and 2026). 5&2 Studios uses a Calibri-like humanist sans for everything (medium-high confidence: rounded terminals, Calibri 'g' and 'y').

palette.notes: Classic palette is navy #1F396C / #00355F + light steel blue #7399C6 + pale blue #E2EBF4 + deep red #9E000B + yellow #FFFF99 highlight; Enstar HTML CSS corroborates (rgb(30,57,109), rgb(0,53,95), rgb(113,153,199), rgb(227,236,245), #9E000B, rgb(249,244,155)). 2026 Select Medical template: black serif titles, steel-blue rules #7A97BA, gray header fill #F2F2F2, navy #092D61, light blue #7297C4, magenta #A6428B, yellow #FDF3AD, green #279E5E / red #A01C1E for positive/negative values, red 'PROPRIETARY & CONFIDENTIAL'. Janus (2026) keeps the classic palette exactly (#1F396C, #00355F, #7399C6, #F2F2F2 shaded terminal column, yellow total rows). 5&2 uses #1F396C core, #00355F footer band and header bars, #7F7F7F gray, pale blue #DCE6F2-ish callout fills, yellow WACC highlight. Myovant reds are slightly warmer (#A0362F).

title_treatment.placement: Top-left, immediately right of the logo block (~13-15% from left edge), vertically aligned with logo; 'INVESTMENT BANKING' two-line small gray caps label top-right with a thin vertical bar to its right. 2026: title flush left at margin, no logo at top (logo moves to bottom-left). Myovant: 'INVESTMENT BANKING DIVISION' instead of 'INVESTMENT BANKING'. 5&2: title flush left with no logo beside it; the logo sits in a thin outlined square at top right; no 'INVESTMENT BANKING' header.
title_treatment.rule: Thin gray full-width horizontal rule ~19-20% down the page under the title zone; 2026 uses steel-blue rules above and below the title.
title_treatment.subtitle_or_units_line: Second line under title in same navy bold, smaller: units in parentheses '($ in millions)' or descriptor with ' | ' separators.
title_treatment.tracker_or_breadcrumb: No tab tracker. PowerSchool/Enstar (2024) print the current section name bottom-left in the footer ('Financial Analysis', 'Supplementary Materials'); Focus (2023) has none. Primary FF analyses carry numbered navy (Focus) or red (Enstar) circles that reappear next to the titles of the corresponding detail pages ('1 Discounted Cash Flow Analysis'). Janus (2026) adds a tab hanging from the top edge, top-left above the logo, naming the analysis ('DCF', 'Present Value of Future Share Price', 'Precedent Transactions', 'Precedent Premia Analysis', 'Public Market Valuation') in white bold on navy #1F396C or light blue. Myovant (2022) uses repeated 'Today's Agenda' pages: rounded pill bars in gray, with the current section highlighted in #7399C6 and numbered circles.

football_field.orientation: horizontal bars, one row per analysis, in a three-column table: Methodology / Implied Equity Value Per Share (Illustrative Price per Share) / Commentary
football_field.row_labels: Focus: analysis name in plain text with numbered navy circles for primary analyses; PowerSchool: label set in white bold inside a colored block matching the bar color; Enstar: navy blocks with red numbered circles plus a 'Key Metric' column. Janus: PowerSchool-style colored label blocks (navy #1F396C for core, #7399C6 for reference) without tinted row backgrounds. Myovant: two-level plain labels (category 'Discounted Cash Flow' / 'Premia Analysis' then the specific analysis). 5&2: navy/gray label blocks, with 'Reference Only:' underlined inside the label and an extra 'Implied Enterprise Value' column.
football_field.methodology_detail_text: Square-bullet commentary column at right with Low/High assumptions (e.g. 'Low: 11.25% WACC, 8.5x Terminal LTM (2027E) P/E')
football_field.reference_only_treatment: Grouped at bottom, marked by a vertical rotated 'For Reference' (Focus: white bold on a #7399C6 band) / 'For Reference Only' (Enstar) / plain rotated text 'For Reference' (PowerSchool); bars in light blue or dark gray. Janus: rotated white 'For Reference Only' on a #7399C6 band. Myovant: a bold navy 'Reference Information' subheader row above a navy rule. 5&2: gray bars and gray label blocks prefixed 'Reference Only:'.
football_field.value_labels: Low and high values in bold outside the bar ends, '$ 40.76' left, '$ 63.12' right (space after $). Janus and 5&2 commentary uses bold 'Low:' / 'High:' lead-ins.
football_field.price_lines: Dashed vertical line(s) through all rows for offer/deal price (green or purple) and undisturbed price (green); labels centered beneath the chart in matching bold color. Myovant: two dashed lines, green undisturbed and orange offer; Janus: single red dashed offer line; 5&2: single dark-red dashed 'Proposal: $3.75' line.
football_field.other: Rows separated by thin gray rules; PowerSchool shades whole rows with pale tints; analyst-target row may show a median marker (orange diamond, 'Median: $22.00')

tables.number_formats: Dollar sign followed by a space: '$ 46.27', '$ 3,963'; dollar sign only on first row/total rows, plain numbers below; thousands commas; per-share to 2 decimals. All seven decks use '$ 45.14', '7.9 x' and '11.00 %' spacing; 5&2 sometimes drops the space in ranges ('$41 – $54').
tables.multiples: One decimal with space before x: '10.7 x', '12.6 x'
tables.percentages: Space before %: '24.1 %', '16 %'; sensitivity WACC labels like '9.000 %' / '10.125 %'
tables.negatives: Parentheses with the % outside: '(7.7)%', '(3.9)'; 2026: red text for negatives, green for positives
tables.mean_median_rows: Bold, highlighted pale yellow #FFFF99 (Focus) or pale blue #E2EBF4 (PowerSchool 'Peer Mean'/'Peer Median' with labels in the middle of the table). Myovant: yellow for median/mean of peers and summary statistics (High/Median/Low), with alternate pale tan/blue groups in the precedent table. Janus: yellow 'TAM Peers' median row and yellow total rows in projections; pale blue #E2EBF4 median in precedents. 5&2: pale blue shaded Mean/Median block.
tables.borders_and_rules: Thin horizontal gray rules between every row (no verticals); thicker/navy rule under column headers; dotted rules in precedent table (PowerSchool)
tables.header_style: Bold navy column headers, grouped headers underlined ('Price / Earnings' over '2023E 2024E'); sensitivity tables use filled navy header bars with white text and a rotated 'WACC' label in a filled side block. Janus DCF: full-width #00355F bar titled 'Discounted Cash Flows Model', terminal column shaded #F2F2F2, rotated 'Growth Rate' label on sensitivities. 5&2: #00355F header bars with white bold text over the sensitivity grids, and rotated 'Illustrative WACC'.
tables.target_or_subject_highlight: Subject company row on top, shaded pale blue #E2EBF4 (Focus) or light gray #F2F2F2 bold (PowerSchool); peer-group subheaders underlined bold navy (Focus) or white text on #7399C6 band (PowerSchool)

distinctive_features: 'INVESTMENT BANKING' small gray two-line label top-right with a short vertical bar, mirrored by 'NN |' page number bottom-right
Logo block top-left on every page (position only)
Space between $ and number, and before x and %: '$ 22.24', '7.8 x', '89 %'
Navy + light steel blue two-tone everywhere (#1F396C/#00355F and #7399C6) with pale blue #E2EBF4 fills
Red dashed boxes/ovals to highlight the offer column or key values (Focus offer column, PowerSchool deal-price column with red dashed ovals)
Pale yellow highlight rows for medians and key totals
Numbered circles linking football-field rows to detail pages
Codename used throughout (Ferdinand, Picasso, Elk) for the company
Football-field commentary column of square bullets with bold 'Low:' / 'High:' lead-ins in every deck that has a football field (Focus, PowerSchool, Myovant, Janus, 5&2, Enstar)
disagreements_between_decks: Templates do not follow dates: Select Medical (Mar 2026) uses the serif brand template; Janus (Mar 2026, same month) uses the classic Arial template; 5&2 (Dec 2025) uses a third, widescreen Calibri template with a navy bottom band and the logo boxed at top right. Select Medical is a market-update deck only (no football field, DCF or comps), and its disclaimer is at the back.
Focus (2023) has a red-boxed 'HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL' legend at top center and no section footer; PowerSchool (2024) has no confidentiality legend but puts the section name bottom-left.

Football field styling differs: Focus uses plain row labels, navy core bars, light-blue reference bars and a light-blue 'For Reference' band; PowerSchool uses colored label blocks, tinted row backgrounds and dark-gray reference rows; offer line green (Focus) vs purple deal / green undisturbed (PowerSchool); Enstar uses red numbered circles and a red dashed 'Total Cash Consideration' box.
Mean/median highlight: yellow (Focus) vs pale blue (PowerSchool).
Focus has no table of contents; PowerSchool and Enstar have a TOC with Roman-numeral sections and divider pages.
Enstar's exhibit is HTML text re-set by the filing agent, so its fonts/sizes are not the original deck's.

Confidentiality legend: red 'PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL' (Myovant 2022), red-boxed 'HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL' (Focus 2023), 'STRICTLY PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL' (Enstar HTML), none (PowerSchool, Janus, 5&2), red 'PROPRIETARY & CONFIDENTIAL' (Select Medical).
Offer-line color is not standardized: green, purple, orange or red depending on the deck; the undisturbed line is green whenever shown.
Navigation: agenda pages with pill bars (Myovant), TOC plus divider pages (PowerSchool, Enstar), analysis tabs at the top edge (Janus), none (Focus, 5&2).
Disclaimer placement: p2 (Focus, PowerSchool, Enstar, Janus, 5&2) vs last page (Myovant, Select Medical).
Header label: 'INVESTMENT BANKING DIVISION' (2022) vs 'INVESTMENT BANKING' (2023+ classic) vs footer 'Investment Banking | N' (5&2).
confidence_notes: Colors measured with palette.py on solid fills in Focus and PowerSchool (core navy #1F396C, chart navy #00355F, light blue #7399C6, pale blue #E2EBF4, yellow #FFFF99, gray rows #DBDBDB/#F2F2F2) and corroborated by Enstar's HTML CSS. Title navy is noisy text sampling (#043159-#0A3356); ~#0A3259 is an estimate. Offer/undisturbed line colors are thin dashed lines, sampled roughly (+/- noticeable). Enstar was not viewed as slide images (none exist); its structure and titles are from HTML text. Point sizes are approximate. Update: three more decks studied. Myovant colors sampled from a grainy 3300x2550 print-scan look, so they are slightly off (navy reads #0A3F75, light blue #6298C0); treat them as the same classic palette. The 5&2 aspect ratio (1.649) fits no standard page; it may be a cropped 16:9.

template_variants.summary: There is no single 2025+ template. The 2025-26 decks use three different looks: Janus (Mar 2026) keeps the classic template; 5&2 (Dec 2025) uses a widescreen Calibri-style one; Select Medical (Mar 2026) uses a serif brand template. Deal team or practice group seems to decide which template is used, not the date.
